name: The Faked
detailed_description:
The Faked is a city-themed multiplayer social deduction game. Players are randomly assigned to one of three roles: Police, Faker, or Neutral.

The Faker is responsible for creating chaos and completing missions.

The Police fight to protect the city and solve suspicious activities.

The Neutral works independently, focusing on their own objectives.

Each role has different tasks and a variety of environments. Observe suspicious behavior, plan your strategy, and reveal your allegiance.

MISSION-FOCUSED GAMEPLAY

Each role has unique tasks to complete. These missions are key to analyzing suspicious behavior or secretly sabotaging others.

Some missions include:

  • Poison Vegetables

  • Rob a Bank

  • Place Illegal Substances

  • Talk to a Prisoner

  • Steal Ammunition

  • and much more awaits you.

PROXIMITY-BASED VOICE CHAT

The Faked offers proximity-based voice communication. You can only hear players nearby, allowing real-time conversations. This feature enables you to make secret alliances and execute your tactics on the fly.

CIVILIAN INTERROGATION SYSTEM

You can talk to civilians (shopkeepers, waiters, street residents) to gather clues.

Civilians may have seen or heard something about what's happening around the city.

Combine the clues, catch contradictions, and uncover the suspects.

DYNAMIC WEATHER CONDITIONS

Each match has a different atmosphere. Dynamic weather conditions, such as rain, fog, and sunny weather, change the city's mood completely.

  • Rain muffles sounds

  • Fog limits visibility

  • Sunny weather makes everything clearer but more dangerous

Although the weather doesn't directly impact gameplay, it significantly shapes your strategy.

MULTIPLAYER SUPPORT

The Faked supports 2 to 10 players. You can either play with friends in private rooms or use the quick match system to face off against different players.

Each match is full of new roles, missions, and surprises. With high replayability, every experience is different.

FEATURES

  • City-themed social deduction game

  • Proximity-based voice chat

  • Dynamic weather system (rain, fog, sun)

  • Different roles: Police, Faker, Neutral

  • Mission-focused gameplay

  • 2-10 player multiplayer support

  • Constantly updated content and high replayability

A CITY FULL OF SUSPICION, STRATEGY, AND CHAOS!

Join The Faked, uncover the criminals or take over the city with secret missions.

Every player could be a potential enemy. Every move matters.

NO TRUST. ONLY OBSERVATION AND ACTION.

Add it to your wishlist now!

The city is waiting. Don’t be late.

short_description: The Faked is a city-themed social deception game. While the police try to maintain order, the Fakers pretend to be innocent and stir up chaos. Complete tasks, earn trust, lie, and survive. Everyone has a role, but no one is what they seem.
